annotation.authors_or_issuer: Chambre des représentants de Belgique (Burton, E.; Scourneau, V.; Jadin, K.)
key_provisions_or_claims: Introduce a precise definition of automated vehicle in the Belgian Road Code (Royal Decree of 1 Dec 1975).
Define a national strategy with the Regions for continued automated vehicle testing, covering human, infrastructure, technology and environmental aspects.
Commission VIAS Institute to assess road infrastructure readiness and needed changes to road legislation.
Assess positive and negative environmental effects of automated vehicles on transport.
Background: Royal Decree of 18 March 2018 art. 59/1 allows ministerial derogations for test vehicles; level 2 is highest allowed in Belgium.
named_instruments_referenced: Belgian Royal Decree of 18 March 2018 on automated vehicle testing
annotation.summary_en: Belgian Chamber of Representatives draft resolution (DOC 55 1848/001, March 2021) asking the federal government to define automated vehicles in the Road Code, define a national testing strategy with the Regions, and commission VIAS Institute to study infrastructure readiness, legal adaptations and environmental effects.
annotation.title_clean: Proposition de résolution visant l'intégration de la définition des véhicules automatisés dans le Code de la route, la poursuite des tests relatifs aux véhicules automatisés en Belgique, l'évaluation des infrastructures routières et autoroutières, ainsi que les effets positifs et/ou négatifs potentiels des véhicules automatisés sur le bilan environnemental du transport en Belgique
annotation.title_en: Draft resolution on integrating the definition of automated vehicles into the Road Code, continuing automated vehicle tests in Belgium, assessing road and motorway infrastructure, and the potential positive and/or negative effects of automated vehicles on the environmental balance of transport in Belgium
annotation.venue: Chambre des représentants de Belgique, DOC 55 1848/001
